title: Zesty Roasted Croatian Steak Tagine
description: A light and juicy Croatian dish featuring a fillet of steak, cooked in a clay tajine vessel with beurre-monte sauce, this recipe is egg-free friendly and perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the fillet steak with paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the clay tajine vessel over medium heat.
Sear the fillet steak for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the clay tajine vessel to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and stir in the beurre-monte and garlic.
Return the vessel to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and stir in the lemon juice.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
